_comment: Task 5 NACL for the PUBLIC subnet (10.20.4.0/24), where the load balancer lives. Stateless: reply traffic needs its own rules. Rules are evaluated lowest-number-first; first match wins; default is deny. The deny for 198.51.100.0/24 must have a lower number than the web-port allows so it overrides them.

inbound._note: block the abusive range on EVERY port, even 80/443 — placed first so it wins over rules 110/120
SSH only from the management subnet
replies coming back from the app subnet land on the LB's ephemeral ports

outbound._note: forward /parse to the app subnet service on port 8000
replies going back to clients land on their ephemeral ports (anywhere)
